shared_elements: single schematic central motif occupying the field of an upright slab
framing line/border running around the edge of the surface
small geometric filler motifs (crescents/lozenges, crossed squares)
justification: Both are upright decorated slabs with an edge-following border enclosing a single dominant schematic motif and some small geometric fillers, which is a very generic scheme. The depicted content differs entirely: A shows a frontal anthropomorphic figure with a rayed head, outstretched arms, hands, legs and a flaring skirt, while B shows an abstract rectilinear-and-curved construction with no recognisable body, plus a grid band, rendered in thin incised line rather than modelled relief.
